release_notes: A technical-review round, not a feature release. An architecture review, an accounting review and an application-security review were run against 2.6.5, and the faults they could reproduce were fixed. This is the beta build of that round. Double clicks no longer corrupt the books. Posting, paying, voiding, reversing, bank coding, bank matching and recording a checkpoint are serialised in one server process. The database also refuses a second ledger entry for the same invoice or bill and a second reversal of the same entry. A second ByteBook process cannot open the same data directory (the packaged entrypoint and the application lifespan both hold the lock). …
